title: RemoteTask
description: Control Plane projection of a task executed on an Execution Node (CONTRACT_SKETCH §5). State after 'delivered' comes only from node events/snapshots. As a single-entity response body it additionally carries api_version (see $defs/response).

title.description: Server-derived: first non-empty line of the task text, truncated to 200 characters.

attempts.description: Core attempt count as last reported by the node (0 before delivery); server-side redelivery of a submit after delivery_failed also counts.

last_event_id.description: event_id of the newest TaskEvent of this task (0 if none).

stale.description: True when the owning node is offline/revoked (last heartbeat older than its lease) and the state is not terminal.

last_seq.description: Addition (CHANGES.md C-003): highest node seq accepted for this task. Returned to nodes in the snapshot response; clients ignore it.

delivery_expires_at.description: Addition (CHANGES.md C-003): expires_at of the pending submit command while state == pending_delivery, else null.

response.description: RemoteTask as a single-entity response body.
